name: Tosu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tosu city emblem in white: a stylised winged device with a pointed base enclosing a swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Tosu, a city in Saga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 6 June 1954.

features.role: Tosu city emblem — a stylised winged device with a pointed base enclosing a swirl
